messages:
tara_ops: Need a quick consult \u2014 adopted a 3yo last week, want to add them to benefits retro to the adoption finalization date (2026-03-20). What docs needed and will premiums be backdated?

henry_benefits: Congrats! Adoption finalization is a QLE. We can do retro effective 2026-03-20 if documentation shows that date. Required docs: finalization decree or court order + completed QLE form. We usually allow 60 days to submit.

maya_payroll: For premiums, we calculate proration from effective date to the end of the pay period the event falls in. If we missed premiums (i.e., you were charged before adding child), we collect the owed premium via payroll deduction over future paychecks, or you can opt for a one-time deduction. Refunds occur if premiums were charged after termination of coverage instead.

benefits-bot: Upload here: https://benefits.redwood.com/qle \u2014 choose "Adoption" and attach decree + DOB proof. Use effective date = 2026-03-20.

tara_ops: DOB proof is passport scanned copy. Is there any tax form I need to sign for dependent coverage?

henry_benefits: No extra tax form for dependent medical/dental. If FSA or dependent care elections change you may need to update FSA elections. Also ask payroll about retro deductions if you prefer spread out.

maya_payroll: If we need to collect premiums retroactively, we will try to spread over 2-4 pay periods unless you select immediate deduction. We'll send a notice before deduction.

tara_ops: Awesome, filing QLE now. Thanks y'all. :party_popper:
